companyDescription: Kidney-disease biotech · TRUTAKNA (atacicept) won FDA accelerated approval Jul 7, 2026 for high-risk IgA nephropathy · Phase 3 ORIGIN eGFR analysis moved up to Q3 2026 ahead of a Q4 sBLA for full approval
priceNote: Down 7.07% today on a Q1 EPS miss (-$1.69 vs -$1.37 consensus) reported alongside earnings — commercial-launch spend, not a thesis change. Now $2.31B market cap, well off the 52-week high ($56.05) and down ~17% just since the last check two weeks ago.
summary: Vera already cleared its biggest hurdle: TRUTAKNA (atacicept) won FDA accelerated approval on Jul 7, 2026 for high-risk IgA nephropathy — a real, completed regulatory win, not a pending binary. Today's -7.07% drop is a Q1 EPS miss (-$1.69 vs -$1.37 consensus) tied to early commercial-launch spend, not a change to the underlying regulatory or clinical story — though a CRO leadership transition (William Turner retiring to advisor, Nancy Boman succeeding) adds a mild, unrelated distraction. The real near-term catalyst is unchanged: the FDA-agreed, moved-up ORIGIN Phase 3 eGFR analysis lands Q3 2026, setting up a Q4 sBLA for full (non-accelerated) approval. At $29.95 the 12-month consensus of $81.79 (14 analysts, Strong Buy) implies +173%, and the highest named target ($110) implies +267% — both unchanged in dollar terms from two weeks ago, so the percentage upside has simply grown as the price fell.

catalysts.name: ORIGIN Phase 3 eGFR Analysis (moved up)
catalysts.description: Vera reached agreement with the FDA to accelerate the primary eGFR (kidney function) analysis from its ORIGIN Phase 3 trial to Q3 2026, ahead of the prior 2027 schedule — this data underpins the case for full (non-accelerated) approval.

catalysts.name: sBLA Filing for Full Approval
catalysts.description: Vera aims to file a supplemental Biologics License Application in Q4 2026 to convert TRUTAKNA's accelerated approval into full approval for IgA nephropathy, contingent on the Q3 eGFR data supporting it.

catalysts.name: TRUTAKNA Commercial Launch
catalysts.description: Already-launched commercial rollout for TRUTAKNA (available within weeks of the Jul 7 approval) — today's Q1 EPS miss shows real launch-phase spend; the market's near-term read on how fast this converts into prescriptions and revenue.

risks: Q1 2026 EPS missed consensus (-$1.69 vs -$1.37) — drove today's -7.07% drop; reflects real commercial-launch spend ramping ahead of revenue, not a regulatory or clinical setback, but it's the second consecutive quarter the market has read launch economics negatively

Chief Regulatory Officer transition — William Turner (who helped secure the accelerated approval) is retiring to a Strategic Advisor role, succeeded by Nancy Boman — a mild, orderly change but real personnel risk during an active confirmatory-trial and launch period

The highest named target ($110, +267%) is a single-analyst figure well above the broader $56-110 range and the $81.79 average — treat it as a real but non-representative ceiling, not the expected case

The Q3 2026 eGFR analysis, while accelerated by FDA agreement, is still a real trial readout with binary risk — a disappointing result could delay or jeopardize the full-approval pathway even with accelerated approval already secured

Commercial launch execution for a newly-approved nephrology drug is genuinely uncertain — physician adoption, payer coverage, and real-world uptake all take time to become visible in the numbers, and today's EPS miss is an early data point that the market is not yet convinced
$2.31B market cap is toward the larger end of names on this board — a smaller re-rate in dollar terms still requires a large percentage move given the current valuation

estimateDates.note: Moved up from 2027 by FDA agreement — underpins the full-approval case

catalystSpot.preRunup: Vera's stock rose ahead of the Jul 7, 2026 FDA decision as anticipation built — a real pre-event runup pattern for this specific name.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: multi-day runup into the confirmed decision date, then a further reaction on the actual approval

postWin.note: VERA's own Jul 7, 2026 accelerated approval drove a +7.05% single-day gain — a real but muted re-rate that shows the market wanted commercial proof before fully pricing in the win, a read reinforced by today's EPS-miss selloff.

postLose.note: Two relevant downside patterns: Celcuity (CELC) fell -15% to -17.6% on Jul 15, 2026 despite a clean FDA approval, purely on a delayed commercial-launch timeline guide — the exact 'approved but market wants launch proof' risk VERA faces; a genuine confirmatory Phase 3 miss can be far worse, as Karyopharm (KPTI) fell -69% on an Aug 2026 Phase 3 primary-endpoint miss.

spotSizing.reason: Mid-cap ($2.31B) biotech with an already-approved product (lower survival/binary risk than a pre-approval name) but real commercial-execution and confirmatory-trial uncertainty ahead — 4% sizing reflects the reduced-but-real risk profile

th.summary: Vera ผ่านด่านใหญ่ที่สุดไปแล้ว: TRUTAKNA (atacicept) ได้ FDA accelerated approval เมื่อ 7 ก.ค. 2026 สำหรับ IgA nephropathy ความเสี่ยงสูง — เป็นชัยชนะ regulatory จริงที่เกิดขึ้นแล้ว วันนี้หุ้นลง -7.07% จาก EPS พลาดเป้า Q1 (-$1.69 เทียบ consensus -$1.37) ซึ่งมาจากค่าใช้จ่ายเปิดตัวเชิงพาณิชย์ ไม่ใช่การเปลี่ยนแปลงเรื่อง regulatory หรือ clinical แต่การเปลี่ยนตัว Chief Regulatory Officer (William Turner เกษียณไปเป็น advisor, Nancy Boman รับช่วงต่อ) เพิ่มความไม่แน่นอนเล็กน้อย catalyst จริงที่รออยู่ยังเหมือนเดิม — การวิเคราะห์ eGFR Phase 3 ORIGIN ที่เลื่อนเร็วขึ้นโดยข้อตกลง FDA จะมาถึงใน Q3 2026 เตรียมยื่น sBLA ใน Q4 เพื่อขออนุมัติเต็มรูปแบบ ที่ราคา $29.95 เป้า consensus 12 เดือน $81.79 (นักวิเคราะห์ 14 ราย, Strong Buy) หมายถึง +173% และเป้าสูงสุด $110 หมายถึง +267% — ตัวเลขเป้าหมายไม่เปลี่ยนจาก 2 สัปดาห์ก่อน เปอร์เซ็นต์ upside แค่โตขึ้นเพราะราคาลง
th.priceNote: ลง 7.07% วันนี้จาก EPS พลาดเป้า Q1 (-$1.69 เทียบ consensus -$1.37) ที่ประกาศพร้อมผลประกอบการ — เป็นเรื่องค่าใช้จ่ายเปิดตัวเชิงพาณิชย์ ไม่ใช่การเปลี่ยน thesis ตอนนี้ market cap $2.31B ห่างจาก 52-week high ($56.05) มาก และลงมาแล้วราว 17% แค่ในช่วง 2 สัปดาห์ที่ผ่านมา
